site.title: Flor Luz Duarte | Unicornio Dark Theme

description.text1: Unicornio Dark is a theme for Visual Studio Code that I developed to share with the members of my free technology community (unicornio.dev).
description.text2: It is a theme specially adapted for the technologies that I use most in my day-to-day life such as: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Astro, Angular, Markdown, MDX, JSON, etc.
description.text3: It is a project that is evolving thanks to the feedback from its users and that I plan to expand to achieve several customization versions and its use in other IDEs, in addition to VSCode.

stack.description: This project was developed to learn how to create a custom theme and how the process works to upload an extension to the Visual Studio Marketplace.

list.text2: VSCode Yeoman extension generator --> To generate theme's boiler-plait files
list.text3: VSCE publishing tool --> To deploy on VS marketplace

spotlight.text1: This project allowed me to learn the necessary details to generate and publish an extension for Visual Studio Code. It was an interesting process that led me to read a lot of documentation in order to publish the extension correctly.

lessons.text1: Developing this theme surprised me with the number of color variables a theme can have and how to optimize their uses to highlight syntax elements of different languages. It was a very good experience and I plan to continue expanding the project with new versions.
